'''Construction kits''' were used before the [[Jedi Civil War]]<ref name="kotor">[[Star_Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]</ref> and through the [[Dark Wars]].<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> They contained all things necessary for a droid to repair itself including electrical regulators designed to isolate malfunctions.<ref name="kotor" /> They could not be used by living beings.<ref name="kotor" /><ref name="TSL" />
